validation.gold_source: Yoon et al. supplied PDF, Fig.2G p.7 and RNAfold methods p.36; these reference-only motifs never enter discovery
validation.null_rule: Full recurring-seed discovery and best-chain maximization for every shuffle; max of local-block and dinucleotide p, Bonferroni across all synthetic and real negative loci in this benchmark
validation.evaluation_policy: Freeze existing configurations and profiles; no threshold tuning from validation outcomes. Published local loci are retrospective development checks, not independent evaluation. Whole similarity components held out for additional RT profile evaluation.
